method: Descriptive pooled unweighted exact-count Cohen kappa for 20 manual count indicators across six sets. One indicator-set count pair is one record; 120 paired records. Not event-level kappa, not six independent match observations. Rates and eight tracking-derived indicators excluded by measurement type.
sample_context: Six sets from two development matches (recorded selection seed 2026); the two matches were accepted after exploratory sampling checks. Estimates are restricted to these records.
